chunks: Where they will dwell so long as heaven and earth endure, unless your Lord will otherwise. Verily your Lord does as He wills.
ai.seo_question: How long will believers stay in Paradise according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is central to the debate on whether Paradise is eternal or temporary, with the majority of scholars interpreting 'what God wills' as a confirmation of permanence rather than a condition for cessation, reflecting God's absolute sovereignty (Faa'lan lima yuriid). The phrase 'as long as the heavens and the earth exist' is often understood metaphorically to denote the duration of the current cosmic order, beyond which lies an eternal reality. This highlights the balance between divine decree and the promised everlasting reward for the faithful.
